question: The Paramhans Mandali was established to work for the abolition of caste in ______.
solution:
The correct answer is 1840.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__**Paramhans Mandali -

__
 
• It was a highly influential and important Hindu socio-religious organization.
 
• This organization was founded by 'Dadoba Pandrung'.
 
• Paramhans Mandali was established to work for the abolition of caste in **1840(1849).​**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9074044cf96dc1d09ca89eac99180c3d7440ade1b364d09d47931959bf693cc8.png] Confusion Points__**

__
 
• We have to choose the **decade** in which it is formed which is 1840(1849)​

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information:__**

 
• In the beginning, it functioned as a secret social-radical society.
 
• The basic philosophy of the Samaj was that only God should be worshipped, true religion is based on love and ethical conduct.
 
• This congregation urged all its members to give up caste restrictions.
 
• The congregation met at fixed times in the homes of various members and sympathizers.
 
• The members used to sing devotional hymns from the Marathi collection, Ratnamala, at the opening and conclusion of these meetings.
 
• Members also recited prayers written by Dadoba as part of the worship service.
